item.title: Sattelkau wins back-to-back on Sunshine Ladies Tour
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau claimed a convincing five-stroke victory in the NTT Data Ladies’ Pro-Am at The Links at Fancourt on Sunday.

item.title: Daffue wins NTT Data Pro-Am in style
item.description: South African MJ Daffue eagled the last to claim an emotional victory in the NTT Data Pro-Am at Fancourt on Sunday.

item.title: Morikawa holds off Scheffler to end trophy drought
item.description: Collin Morikawa claimed a tense victory at the Pebble Beach Pro-Am in California on Sunday, fending off a final-day charge by world No 1 Scottie Scheffler.
